scope: Read-only full small original command streams and actual root/reader/lease/HEAD/refs/index metadata. No Git invocation, archive/loose-object body reread, compiler, performance or root ref mutation.
limits: The reviewed d4c9 tool itself fully validated 62MB archive/header/GitOID/payload hashes during execution; this peer validates its complete recorded stream and final metadata, not a second independent62MB scan.
Actual publication of these blobs into commits and remote push is separate; this result certifies only preload and ordinary local readers.
Protected TMP store contains permanent Git data and must never be cache-cleaned.
